fusions.name: Laid Open for All
fusions.desc: Tears open every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 26 damage, and restores 10 health to you. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Morsel
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A claw tears into the first enemy it meets, dealing 18 damage, and restores 14 health to you.

fusions.name: Termite Banquet
fusions.desc: You gorge and restore 16 health. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Surplus Plating
fusions.desc: The moment you are back at full health, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
